run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-15T05:29:34Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend-proxy is backed by frontend-proxy's own error signals: at 2026-11-15T05:35:00Z its ingress spans carried STATUS_CODE_ERROR at 0.307407 spans/s and its router frontend egress spans at 0.296296 spans/s (versus 9.733333 spans/s and 9.755556 spans/s UNSET on the same operations), and its access log shows POST /api/checkout returning HTTP 500 from 05:29:54.908Z to 05:31:54.401Z. Each hop shows its own errors: frontend's POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans at 0.296296 spans/s; checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge spans at 0.156098 spans/s with its log showing repeated [PlaceOrder] lines and no payment or order success lines between 05:30:59Z and 05:31:19Z. The deepest supported cause is the payment Deployment rollout at 05:29:47Z: the old pod payment-55766d76b9-5frt4 was stopped and deleted at 05:29:52Z while the replacement pod payment-79d86bf97f-9pm9t (container started 05:29:51Z, no readiness, liveness or startup probe defined) logged its gRPC server start only at 05:31:08.791Z and its first Charge request only at 05:31:55.991Z, leaving checkout without a serving payment backend for about two minutes. A separate, pre-existing baseline of isolated 503 upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} responses on frontend-proxy (for example 05:28:29.748Z) predates the first checkout 500 and the alert state change at 05:29:34Z, so the initial firing may have been driven by that baseline noise rather than the checkout burst.

claims.text: frontend-proxy's own span metrics at 2026-11-15T05:35:00Z show a 5-minute STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate of 0.307407 spans/s on operation ingress and 0.296296 spans/s on operation router frontend egress, against STATUS_CODE_UNSET rates of 9.733333 spans/s and 9.755556 spans/s on the same operations.

frontend-proxy access log records POST /api/checkout as HTTP 500 via_upstream with 21-byte bodies from 2026-11-15T05:29:54.908Z through 2026-11-15T05:31:54.401Z, and the same path returns HTTP 200 again from 2026-11-15T05:32:18.199Z onward.

frontend's own spans show STATUS_CODE_ERROR at 0.296296 spans/s for POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder at 05:35:00Z, with 0.281481 spans/s UNSET on the same operations; frontend's other listed operations (GET, POST, GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, GET /api/data, tcp.connect, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem) read 0 error rate at that instant.

checkout's own spans show STATUS_CODE_ERROR at 0.156098 spans/s on oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and on oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge at 05:35:00Z, with 0.281481 spans/s UNSET on both; no other checkout operation appears with a nonzero error rate in the all-service error sweep at that time.

checkout pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-k45hc logged only [PlaceOrder] for 18 order attempts between 05:30:59.103Z and 05:31:19.916Z, with no payment went through, order placed or order confirmation email sent lines, whereas the same pod logged payment went through, order placed and order confirmation email sent for orders between 05:32:13.348Z and 05:32:29.701Z.

payment pod payment-79d86bf97f-9pm9t was created at 2026-11-15T05:29:47Z with its payment container started at 05:29:51Z and restartCount 0; its oldest retained payment log line is payment gRPC server started on port 8080 at 05:31:08.791Z, and no Charge request received line appears until 05:31:55.991Z, after which charges are followed by Transaction complete.

Deployment payment scaled ReplicaSet payment-79d86bf97f from 0 to 1 at 05:29:47Z (Created pod: payment-79d86bf97f-9pm9t) and scaled ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 from 1 to 0 at 05:29:52Z; pod payment-55766d76b9-5frt4 received Stopping container payment and the old ReplicaSet reported Deleted pod: payment-55766d76b9-5frt4, both at 05:29:52Z.

Inside the authorized window the only ScalingReplicaSet, SuccessfulCreate and SuccessfulDelete events returned belong to payment: Deployment payment scaling payment-79d86bf97f up and payment-55766d76b9 down, plus the ReplicaSet create and delete of the payment pods.

The payment Deployment is at revision 2, generation 2, spec.replicas 1, strategy RollingUpdate with maxSurge 25 percent and maxUnavailable 25 percent, runs container payment from image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment on containerPort 8080 named service, and defines no readinessProbe, livenessProbe or startupProbe; its status shows 1 readyReplica and 1 availableReplica.

payment's own oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge spans report STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0 in every evaluated 5-minute bucket from 05:35:00Z through 05:45:00Z, and payment logged Charge request received followed by Transaction complete for the charges it handled at 05:31:57Z to 05:32:03Z and at 05:40:17Z to 05:40:43Z.

frontend-proxy logged 503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} on GET /api/products/L9ECAV7KIM at 05:28:29.748Z (before the checkout 500 burst), on GET /api/data/ at 05:32:38.297Z and 05:32:38.421Z, and on GET /api/data/?contextKeys=accessories at 05:34:21.361Z; frontend-proxy ingress error spans were already nonzero (0.003704 to 0.007407 spans/s) in the 05:15:00Z to 05:30:00Z evaluation buckets.

At query time all 21 pods in otel-demo were Running and Ready with restartCount 0, including checkout-5dccddf8bb-k45hc and payment-79d86bf97f-9pm9t, and the payment Deployment reports 1 ready and 1 available replica.

In the all-service error sweep at 05:35:00Z, accounting, ad, cart, currency, email, image-provider, product-catalog, quote, recommendation and shipping operations all read error rate 0, as did payment's listed operations; the only other nonzero reading was fraud-detection operation flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream at 0.003704 spans/s.

Deepest supported cause: the payment Deployment rollout created payment-79d86bf97f-9pm9t at 05:29:47Z and removed the serving pod payment-55766d76b9-5frt4 at 05:29:52Z, but the replacement payment process only logged its gRPC server start at 05:31:08.791Z and handled its first charge at 05:31:55.991Z; because the payment container defines no readiness probe, the new pod counted as Ready before the gRPC server was listening. In that gap checkout's PaymentService/Charge span errors arose, PlaceOrder failures propagated to frontend /api/checkout 500 responses, and those 500 responses are the frontend-proxy ingress errors behind the alert; the windows line up (first checkout 500 at 05:29:54.908Z, about 2s after the old pod was deleted; last 500 at 05:31:54.401Z, about 1.6s before the first logged charge at 05:31:55.991Z).

The alert state change at 05:29:34Z, about 20s before the first logged checkout 500 at 05:29:54.908Z, is consistent with a threshold of error rate above 0 being tripped by pre-existing single-request 5xx noise (a 503 connection_termination was logged at 05:28:29.748Z and frontend-proxy ingress error spans were nonzero in earlier buckets), after which the payment-related checkout 500 burst produced the larger sustained rate; this is unverified because the alert rule definition could not be read.

flagd fault injection was considered as the cause of the checkout and payment errors, since the flagd-config ConfigMap currently sets paymentFailure defaultVariant to 100% and paymentUnreachable defaultVariant to on. It was rejected as the explanation for this burst: that ConfigMap value is the state at query time (05:53:46Z) and cannot establish the state at 05:29Z, and the same config still declares paymentFailure at 100% while payment completed charges normally at 05:31:57Z to 05:32:03Z and 05:40:17Z to 05:40:43Z, reported STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0 on its Charge spans through the 05:45:00Z bucket, and checkout showed 0 Charge errors in the 05:40:00Z and 05:45:00Z buckets, so the burst is bounded by the payment pod replacement rather than by those values.

Add a readiness probe on the payment container (TCP or gRPC on containerPort 8080, plus a startupProbe covering the roughly 77s initialisation seen here) so the payment Service does not route traffic before the gRPC server is listening, and avoid taking the only payment replica out of service during rollouts (for example maxUnavailable 0 for single-replica workloads); separately review the RequestErrorRate alert threshold and denominator, because an error rate above 0 fires on isolated baseline 503 connection_termination responses such as the one at 05:28:29.748Z that are unrelated to the checkout burst.

gaps: Jaeger held no trace data for the burst window: traces_search for frontend-proxy over 05:30:00Z to 05:36:00Z returned status no_data (evidence b6d71f69-e827-409f-9a7f-6d9c062079a6-t1:845bcdbf-9eae-47a8-8329-e5e6ef932f05), and the retrievable span sample covers only 05:21:15Z to 05:21:17Z with successful checkout spans, so the gRPC status codes and error details of the failed PaymentService/Charge calls are unknown.

The RequestErrorRate rule definition could not be read: list_prometheus_rules for rule_name RequestErrorRate returned status no_data (evidence 5211b9a3-fcfd-4898-a6c6-bafe49195139-t1:d7d7d421-70e3-4937-9cfc-521e9cfee67c), so the rule expression, evaluation window, denominator and threshold behind the reported 0.0111 value are unknown and the exact trigger of the 05:29:34Z firing cannot be confirmed.
change_history is not integrated, so who or what changed the payment Deployment to revision 2 at 05:29:47Z, and whether the flagd-config values changed at that time, could not be determined.

kube-state-metrics series returned nothing in this target: kube_deployment_status_replicas_available for deployment payment returned status no_data over 05:20:00Z to 05:45:00Z (evidence 19915cd4-dbaa-4a63-a106-30fe41c971ae-t0:acabd53e-910c-41e4-aea4-57f4eabb89b0) and kube_pod_container_info for the current payment pod returned status no_data (evidence 4e280ec1-a603-490e-984b-37268a39fb26-t1:09a6d701-aff5-4ade-b297-8383e8036d84), so historical availability and image digests during the rollout are unknown.

The old payment pod payment-55766d76b9-5frt4 was deleted at 05:29:52Z and no logs, status or events for its container state before deletion were returned, so its serving state in the seconds before deletion cannot be verified.

The payment log line 14 UNAVAILABLE: Connection dropped at 05:32:04.851Z and the roughly 47s between the new payment gRPC start log at 05:31:08.791Z and the first logged charge at 05:31:55.991Z are unexplained by the evidence; gRPC channel reconnect or endpoint propagation delay is unverified.

Log and metric coverage is bounded: payment retained only 705 log lines from 05:31:08.791Z to 05:40:43.897Z, several log reads were cut by their limits (for example evidence 9ef54cb5-b3f3-4df1-abe6-a18ea07a6c8f-t1:8d532620-1a4a-40b3-9124-d8b552f3e919 and 0aaf84fb-495d-481f-a233-cb2e5a1333bd-t0:99124b30-fc73-49c2-8a8b-d69dc082d0c3), so lines outside those bounds are unknown rather than absent.

traces_search_by_tags for checkout with tags error=true and otel.status_code=ERROR returned status no_data (evidence 5339b9d7-c9d6-4ad1-b2ea-c6ea98c1b0d1-t0:16fc1150-3be4-4a41-96f8-27476884ae24 and 5953a23d-98e8-4403-88bd-f4195a58e872-t1:ea504cea-3257-41f8-be04-7d75ea015072), so the failed checkout spans could not be inspected directly.
next_steps: Retrieve the RequestErrorRate rule definition and its evaluation history to confirm what drove the 05:29:34Z state change (baseline 503 versus checkout burst).

Check the change record for payment Deployment revision 2 under Helm release otel-demo to learn what was rolled out at 05:29:47Z and whether the same change touched the flagd paymentFailure and paymentUnreachable values.
Add and validate a payment readiness and startup probe, then confirm in a later rollout that no frontend-proxy ingress errors occur while the payment process initialises.
